description:
The Tumalo is our latest dirt tourer, combining all the best attributes our mountain touring and gravel bikes offer. Not to be confused with a drop bar mountain bike or monster cross gravel bike, the Tumalo is carefully designed as a lightweight, off-road bikepacking and touring machine. With features like long chain-stays and extended frame reach, this bike has increased traction, load stability, and handling. Choose from an ENVE Mountain Boost carbon fork for fast pursuits or a RockShox suspension fork for more comfort on rough terrain.
Key Features That Set the Tumalo Apart:

Versatile Tire Compatibility: Optimized for 29" Boost wheels with clearance for tires ranging from 2.2" to 3.0".
Lightweight Durability: Crafted with OMNICROM alloy Life and Max steel tubing for strength without added weight.
Customizable Fork Options: Choose the ENVE Mountain Boost fork for speed and precision or the RockShox Reba RL 120mm suspension fork for comfort and control (available as a free upgrade!).
Enhanced Stability and Handling: Long chainstays and extended frame reach provide exceptional traction and load balance for confident off-road rides.
Shifting Options for Every Rider: Frame setups include Shimano GRX, Pinion C1.12, Pinion SmartShift, or electronic Di2 for smooth, reliable gear changes.
PNW Loam Dropper Post: Make saddle adjustments on the go for efficient climbing and descents.

Why Choose the Tumalo?The Tumalo offers unmatched versatility, making it a top choice for riders searching for the best bikepacking bike or the perfect hybrid between a gravel bike and a mountain bike. Engineered for adventure and built to last, the Tumalo takes you farther with ease. Dreaming about a Pinion Drive with SmartShift?! The Tumalo is perfect for this!
Ready to Ride?
Experience the difference of a purpose-built dirt tourer. Scroll below to learn more about the Tumalo and start your next adventure today!
